maddeler.e:
ننضرب (form VII)
# نَنْضَرِبُ (nanḍaribu) /nan.dˤa.ri.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# نَنْضَرِبَ (nanḍariba) /nan.dˤa.ri.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# نَنْضَرِبْ (nanḍarib) /nan.dˤa.rib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
